reuse.why: The six providers now share one prepareBankAccountLink built on the existing link helpers, but replaceExistingAccountLink re-implements both the holder lookup of ensureAccountIsNotLinked and the field clearing of unlinkAccount instead of sharing them.

duplication.why: The new helper copies the 'which other account holds this bank account' SQL verbatim from ensureAccountIsNotLinked and the unlink field list verbatim from unlinkAccount.

placement.why: The replacement lives in accounts/link.ts beside the other link guards and the dispatch in one app.ts helper, consistent with the tree's layering.

scope.why: Only the flag plumbing, the new link helper and its tests.

maintainability.why: Centralising the pre-link checks is an improvement, but the 'unlinked' state is now defined in two places and the holder query in two, so a change to either can diverge.

bypasses_abstraction.where: link.replaceExistingAccountLink clears account_id/bank/balances/sync source itself rather than sharing the unlink state change with unlinkAccount in accounts/app.ts.

disguised_duplication.where: Both copies (holder query, unlink field set) are verbatim, not disguised.
